Rate limiting

API requests are limited to 1 request per second.

Requests over the limit receive an HTTP 429 Too Many Requests response with a plain-text body of Retry later. No Retry-After header is sent.

To stay within the limit:

  • Send requests sequentially rather than in parallel.
  • On a 429, wait at least one second before retrying, and back off further if 429s continue.

Add stock lot

Adds a new stock lot to the specified inventory item.

Authorizations:
BasicAuth
path Parameters
inventory_id
required
integer

inventory item record ID

Request Body schema: application/json
delivery_method_id
required
integer
location_id
integer
vendor_id
integer
vendor_reference
string
vendor_item_number
string
count
required
number
cost
required
number
cost_entered_is_total_cost
boolean

True when cost is the total for the lot rather than the cost per unit

lot_code
required
string

Required unless generate_lot_code is true

barcode
string
serial_number
string
generate_lot_code
boolean

Generates the lot code, when automatic sequencing is on for the account

generate_barcode
boolean

Generates the barcode, when automatic sequencing is on for the account

generate_serial_number
boolean

Generates the serial number, when automatic sequencing is on for the account

expiration_date
string
received_date
string

Date and time received, in the API user's date and time style

stock_description
string
status
required
string
Enum: "active" "inactive" "on_hold" "quarantined"

The new stock's status

Responses

Production base URL

https://my.wherefour.com/api/v1/inventory/{inventory_id}/stocks

Sandbox base URL

https://sandbox.wherefour.com/api/v1/inventory/{inventory_id}/stocks

Search for inventory item

Returns inventory items that match the given name or SKU. Multiple matches may be returned.

Authorizations:
BasicAuth
query Parameters
page
integer

Results page to view

Request Body schema: application/json

Search can be performed based on EITHER the inventory item name, OR a single SKU or an array of SKUs. The inventory item name will take precedence over the SKU parameter. Multiple matches may be returned.

name
string

Part of the inventory item's name

string or Array of strings

One SKU, or an array of SKUs

location_id
integer

Responses

Production base URL

https://my.wherefour.com/api/v1/inventory/search

Sandbox base URL

https://sandbox.wherefour.com/api/v1/inventory/search

Auto Pick and Ship

Performs a "pick and ship" for the specified order. Wherefour will auto-select available lot coded inventory, based on each inventory item's pull strategy, to fulfill the order. If the location is specified, only inventory at that location will be considered. If not enough inventory is available, a partial shipment will be created. Results of the shipment, with the selected stock lots, will be returned.

The optional ship_date param can be used to specify the timestamp of the shipment. Date/time should be in the format "2021-02-02 12:00 AM" and in the same time zone as the user's Wherefour settings.

The request will be rejected with a 422 response if the order has already been fulfilled, if shipments are blocked for the customer, or if the order's order status does not allow shipments.

Authorizations:
BasicAuth
path Parameters
customer_id
required
integer

customer record ID

order_id
required
integer

order record ID

Request Body schema:
delivery_method
required
string
location_id
integer

ID of the Wherefour Location to pull stock from. If not provided, auto ship will pull available stock lots from any location.

tracking_number
string

Tracking number to record for the shipment.

ship_date
string

Responses

Production base URL

https://my.wherefour.com/api/v1/customers/{customer_id}/orders/{order_id}/auto_ship

Sandbox base URL

https://sandbox.wherefour.com/api/v1/customers/{customer_id}/orders/{order_id}/auto_ship

Request samples

  • Payload
Content type
{
  • "tracking_number": "123456",
  • "delivery_method": "UPS Ground",
  • "location_id": 1
}

Response samples

  • 200
Content type
application/json
{
  • "messages": [
    • {
      • "message": "Auto pick and ship request for Order #SO1042 has been queued."
      }
    ]
}

Create purchase order

Creates a purchase order for the vendor. New purchase orders are drafts unless status is sent. Each line's unit price comes from the vendor's price list for its quantity, unless override_unit_price is sent. The subtotal and total are always worked out by Wherefour.

Authorizations:
BasicAuth
path Parameters
vendor_id
required
integer

vendor record ID

Request Body schema: application/json
purchase_number
string

Defaults to the next purchase order number

purchase_date
string

Defaults to today

deliver_by_date
string
status
string
Enum: "draft" "open" "complete" "canceled" "archived"

Defaults to draft

payment_term_id
integer

Defaults to the vendor's payment term

delivery_method_id
integer

Defaults to the vendor's delivery method

bill_to_address_id
integer

A facility address. Defaults to the organization's main address

deliver_to_address_id
integer

A facility address. Defaults to the organization's main address

vendor_reference
string
instructions
string
tax
number
shipping
number
discount
number
required
Array of objects
Array of objects (custom_line_items)

Responses

Production base URL

https://my.wherefour.com/api/v1/vendors/{vendor_id}/purchases

Sandbox base URL

https://sandbox.wherefour.com/api/v1/vendors/{vendor_id}/purchases

Update purchase order

Updates one of the vendor's purchase orders. A purchase order can't be changed once stock has been received against it; the request returns 422. Each line's unit price comes from the vendor's price list for its quantity, unless override_unit_price is sent. The subtotal and total are always worked out by Wherefour.

BasicAuth
path Parameters
vendor_id

integer

purchase_id

integer

Reports

Reports.

Get inventory adjustment activity for a date range

Lists inventory adjustment activity for a date range. The IDs of records returned are for the adjustment record.

Authorizations:
BasicAuth
query Parameters
start_date_time
required
string

Start date/time for the oldest adjustment record to return, based on the adjustment's effective_at timestamp

end_date_time
required
string

End date/time for the newest adjustment record to return, based on the adjustment's effective_at timestamp

activity_types
Array of arrays

Restrict records to the provided adjustment activity types

category_ids
Array of arrays

Restrict records to inventory and stock lot that belong to the provided category IDs

customer_ids
Array of arrays

Restrict records to activity associated with specific customer IDs

inventory_ids
Array of arrays

Restrict records to the provided inventory IDs

location_ids
Array of arrays

Restrict records to the provided location IDs

statuses
Array of arrays

Restrict records to stock lots with the provided statuses

user_ids
Array of arrays

Restrict records to adjustments made by the provided used IDs

vendor_ids
Array of arrays

Restrict records to activity associated with specific vendor IDs

lot_code
Array of arrays

Restrict records to adjustments made only to stock lots with the provided lot code

barcode
Array of arrays

Restrict records to adjustments made only to stock lots with the provided barcode

serial_number
Array of arrays

Restrict records to adjustments made only to stock lots with the provided serial number

page
integer

Results page to view

Request Body schema: application/json
start_date_time
required
string

Start of the report, as a date and time

end_date_time
required
string

End of the report, as a date and time

activity_types
Array of strings

Adjustment reasons to include, such as purchase, shipment, manual_count or transfer_in. reduction includes every kind of reduction.

category_ids
Array of integers
customer_ids
Array of integers
inventory_ids
Array of integers
location_ids
Array of integers
statuses
Array of strings

Stock statuses

user_ids
Array of integers
lot_code
string
barcode
string
serial_number
string

integer

List custom line definitions

Lists the custom line definitions for custom line items, sorted by name. Use a definition's id as custom_line_definition_id when adding custom line items to a document, or to a document's lines in *_item_details_attributes. Inactive definitions are included unless filtered out.

Authorizations:
BasicAuth
query Parameters
page
integer

Results page to view

per_page
integer

Results per page, up to 100

active
boolean

Only active (true) or inactive (false) definitions

document
string
Enum: "credits" "invoices" "orders" "purchases" "quotes" "shipments" "standing_orders"

Only definitions that can be used on this kind of document

customer_id
integer

Only definitions open to all customers or limited to this customer

vendor_id
integer

Only definitions open to all vendors or limited to this vendor

inventory_id
integer

Only definitions open to all inventory items or limited to this item. These definitions can be added under a line for this item

updated_at
string

Only definitions updated on or after this time

Responses

Production base URL

https://my.wherefour.com/api/v1/settings/custom_line_definitions

Sandbox base URL

https://sandbox.wherefour.com/api/v1/settings/custom_line_definitions

Update Credit

Updates an existing credit

Authorizations:
BasicAuth
path Parameters
credit_id
required
integer

credit record ID

customer_id
required
integer

customer record ID

Request Body schema: application/json
credit_number
string
credit_date
string

A date such as 2026-10-22 is saved as midnight in the API user's time zone. A date and time with an offset, such as 2026-10-22T09:00:00-07:00, is saved as given.

status
string
order_id
integer
invoice_id
integer
salesperson_id
integer
credit_from_address_id
integer

Facility Address ID, not Facility ID or Customer Address ID

customer_message
string or null
internal_notes
string or null
Array of objects
Array of objects (custom_line_items-2)

Responses

Production base URL

https://my.wherefour.com/api/v1/customers/{customer_id}/credits/{credit_id}

Sandbox base URL

https://sandbox.wherefour.com/api/v1/customers/{customer_id}/credits/{credit_id}

Formulas

BOMs, disassemblies and kits.

List formulas

Lists formulas with optional name, type and search_type filters

BasicAuth
query Parameters
name
string

Name of the formula to search for

type
required
string

Type of formula to search for, one of: (boms, kits, disassemblies)

search_type
required
string

Type of data to search for, one of: (formula, formula_version)

Search formulas

Searches formulas or formula versions for matches on name type and search_type filters

Authorizations:
BasicAuth
query Parameters
name
required
string

Name of the formula to search for

type
required
string

Type of formula to search for, one of: (boms, kits, disassemblies)

search_type
required
string

Type of data to search for, one of: (formula, formula_version)

Responses

Production base URL

https://my.wherefour.com/api/v1/formulas/search

Sandbox base URL

https://sandbox.wherefour.com/api/v1/formulas/search
